cards.quote: His piercing blue eyes, chiseled features, and chiseled physique made him an instant fan favorite, but it was his lightning-quick reflexes and uncanny ability to read the game that had earned him a starting spot in A.S. Pirae's lineup. As Yegor made his way to the locker room, he exchanged nods and words of encouragement with his teammates, his thick Russian accent a gentle reminder of his foreign roots. The team's captain, the grizzled veteran Giannis Papadopoulos, clapped him on the back, his eyes gleaming with a mixture of admiration and gratitude. "Tonight, Yegor, we need you to be the difference-maker," he said, his voice low and urgent. Yegor nodded, his mind already focused on the task at hand. He had played in countless high-stakes matches back in Russia, but there was something about the electric atmosphere of the Karaiskakis Stadium that brought out the best in him. As he changed into his kit, the familiar sensation of the A.S. Pirae crest on his chest seemed to imbue him with an extra dose of confidence.

raw_card.claim: Yegor Kortsov represents FC Leningradets Leningrad Oblast.
